The '''1992 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 48th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. Each team played 22 games with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve are relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon]] are promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between the two second placed teams in the two groups of the 1. divisjon and number ten in the Tippeligaen.

This season was the first of a 13-year-long streak of [[Rosenborg BK|Rosenborg]] victories.

==Relegation play-offs==
The qualification play-off matches were contested between [[HamKam]] (10th in Tippeligaen), [[Drøbak-Frogn IL|Drøbak-Frogn]] (2nd in the First Division - Group A), and [[Strømmen IF|Strømmen]] (2nd in the First Division - Group B). HamKam won one game and drew one and remained in Tippeligaen.

;Results
*Match 1: Ham-Kam 2–1 Drøbak/Frogn
*Match 2: Strømmen 4–4 Ham-Kam
